details:
tailwind-animationlab (2.0.6) is a Tailwind CSS plugin from the fake job interview campaign behind MAL-2026-17665 and MAL-2026-17666: the same Animate.css integration template, README and description, published by adriannamrr on 2026-09-28. src/motion.js:5 requires the private scoped package @jasperquinn/postcss-motion-helpers, which is not readable on the public registry and resolves only with the npm token committed in the lure repository's web/.npmrc, so the code it delivers runs when tailwind.config.js loads the plugin and the dev server starts. The published tarball contains no install scripts and no network code; the payload lives in the private dependency, which was not retrieved. Twenty-six such packages under seventeen accounts were published between 2026-07-28 and 2026-10-09.

## Source: amazon-inspector (7483ed23a403d8a8e0cabff078d5ac5df82460253f33da7df31bb3d73e863d0e)
The package contents show no install-time or import-time execution of remote code, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), no environment scraping, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms. No lifecycle scripts fetching and executing external payloads are present.
